name: Databricks
label: Databricks SQL Statement Execution API 2.0
description: Official Databricks SQL Statement Execution API 2.0. POST /api/2.0/sql/statements, GET /api/2.0/sql/statements/{statement_id}, POST …/cancel. Placeholder baseUrl https://dbc-xxxxxxxx-xxxx.cloud.databricks.com — edit api_spec.baseUrl to the workspace origin (engine cannot bind host). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer access_token (PAT or OAuth). Customer owns the workspace. access_token is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. execute.sql requires warehouse_id and statement; optional wait_timeout, catalog, schema, parameters. statement.get / statement.cancel require statement_id. statement.cancel POST body is empty (warehouse_id is not sent). Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"execute.sql","warehouse_id":"abc","statement":"SELECT 1","wait_timeout":"10s"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'execute.sql' | 'statement.get' | 'statement.cancel'.

schema.label: warehouse_id
schema.description: SQL warehouse id for execute.sql. Warehouse must be running. CAN USE required.

schema.label: statement
schema.description: SQL text for execute.sql. Official JSON key statement. Prefer :name placeholders with parameters[].

schema.label: wait_timeout
schema.description: Official string, e.g. 10s (0s or 5s–50s). This node does not auto-poll after CONTINUE.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Named SQL parameters for execute.sql. Official array of {name, value, type}. Docs: https://docs.databricks.com/api/workspace/statementexecution/executestatement

schema.label: statement_id
schema.description: Path id for statement.get and statement.cancel.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (statement_id, status.state, manifest). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | statement.get | statement.cancel.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Bearer PAT or OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Never log or place on INPUT. OAuth M2M exchange is not performed by this node.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 60. Keep at or above wait_timeout when waiting synchronously.
